title.zh: 《CLARITY法案》已纳入民主党所提加密募资上限，但仍遭投票反对
title.en: 《CLARITY法案》已纳入民主党所提加密募资上限，但仍遭投票反对

current_state.zh: Senator Lummis said Democrats' requested crypto fundraising caps — lowering the annual exemption from $75M to $50M with a $200M lifetime ceiling — were accepted into the CLARITY market-structure bill, yet Democrats still voted against the consumer-protection rule.
current_state.en: Senator Lummis said Democrats' requested crypto fundraising caps — lowering the annual exemption from $75M to $50M with a $200M lifetime ceiling — were accepted into the CLARITY market-structure bill, yet Democrats still voted against the consumer-protection rule.
